"name": "Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')"}], "description": "### Impact
An application that passes attacker-controlled data into joi's custom message configuration (`messages()`, `message()`, `prefs({ messages })`, `Joi.extend({ messages })` or `rule({ message })`) lets the attacker write properties onto `Object.prototype`, where every object in the process then inherits them. A key named `__proto__` was treated as a language name, and the code reused the object it found at that key, which resolves to the prototype rather than to a new own property; a key named `constructor` did the same to the `Object` function's statics. A consuming application that gates on the mere presence of a property (`if (user.isAdmin)`) can be made to take the wrong branch for every object it inspects.

This is not reachable from data that joi validates. Custom messages are schema-construction configuration, normally written by the application developer. Exploitation therefore requires an application that feeds untrusted input straight into schema construction.

### Patches
Upgrade to version 18.2.5 or 17.13.6.

### Workarounds
Do not pass untrusted input into `messages()`, `message()`, `prefs({ messages })`, `Joi.extend({ messages })` or `rule({ message })`. Or validate that they don't contain any `__proto__` or `constructor` property.", "epss": {"percentage": 0.00255, "percentile": 0.16909}, "ghsa_id": "GHSA-6w3j-5fw6-r9vr", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-09-08T20:55:58Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6w3j-5fw6-r9vr", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-6w3j-5fw6-r9vr"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-84368"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-09-01T21:18:47Z", "published_at": "2026-09-08T20:55:58Z", "references": ["https://github.com/hapijs/joi/security/advisories/GHSA-6w3j-5fw6-r9vr", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-84368", "https://github.com/hapijs/joi/pull/3138", "https://github.com/hapijs/joi/pull/3139", "https://github.com/hapijs/joi/commit/8d0b808f3e874d28f9078f61b7742290989afb36", "https://github.com/hapijs/joi/commit/90d07571923c90e3432a328fc041d1cda03d30fa", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6w3j-5fw6-r9vr"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/hapijs/joi/security-advisories/GHSA-6w3j-5fw6-r9vr", "severity": "low", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/hapijs/joi", "summary": "joi: Prototype pollution via a `__proto__` language key in custom messages", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-09-08T20:56:00Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-6w3j-5fw6-r9vr", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "17.13.6", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "joi"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": ">= 17.2.0, < 17.13.6"}, {"first_patched_version": null, "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "@hapi/joi"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": ">= 16.0.0, <= 17.1.1"}, {"first_patched_version": "18.2.5", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "joi"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": ">= 18.0.0, < 18.2.5"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
